Q: How to normalize complex JSON using pandas? A:

It may need other functions to convert list with dictionary to columns

It seems it may first .str[0] to convert list with single object (dict) to dict, and next .apply(pd.Series) to convert elements of this dict to columns

print( df_rows["rows_fieldgroups"].str[0].apply(pd.Series) )

gives dataframe with

          name fieldnames
0   main attr.   [q1, q2]
1  added attr.   [a1, a2]
2   main attr.   [t1, y7]

and now you may rename columns and merge then with other elements.

Q: Prevent a label from "scrolling" when a count is being updated from a ListView control A:

Look what I found:

' Inside your Form Class
Private isIdleHandlerSet As Boolean = False

Private Sub ListView1_SelectedIndexChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles ListView1.SelectedIndexChanged
    ' Wait until the application settles, not just the first selection change
    If Not isIdleHandlerSet Then
        isIdleHandlerSet = True
        AddHandler Application.Idle, AddressOf ListView_SelectionFinished
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub ListView_SelectionFinished(sender As Object, e As EventArgs)
    ' Remove the handler immediately to avoid recurring calls
    RemoveHandler Application.Idle, AddressOf ListView_SelectionFinished
    isIdleHandlerSet = False

    ' Logic here runs only ONCE, when all items have finished changing
    Debug.WriteLine($"Final count: {ListView1.SelectedItems.Count}")
End Sub

Snoopy

Q: List of deadkeys for current keyboard A:

This worked for me:
1. download MSKLC https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=102134
2. Use File/Load existing keyboard ... Slovak
3. Save as SlovakOK.klc

find "->" SlovakOK.klc

Modalities:
find does support UTF16 but does not support regex
findstr does support regex but does not support UTF16
grep did not find anything in UTF16 file as it requires text patterning in UTF16 as well or other reason, but I did not want to write pattern string in UTF16 notation
working grep for such scenario would be grepuni https://github.com/mrkbutty/grepuni

grepuni SlovakOK.klc "->"

more options grepping binary files and UTF16

Note: MSKLC is good thing in all cases, because after some update or other system change in my Win10 this year key for ´ and ˇ acutes did not work anymore properly for typing acutes as óĺď via Slovak keyboard - typing double apostrophe ´´ inspite of dead key ´ for following óĺ and double ˇˇ inspite of dead key ˇ for following ď.
I found out with MSKLC, that Slovak keyboard was faulty in Win10 - f.e. mappings for ´ acutes were totally missing inside exported Slovak.klc on Win10.
I saved the SlovakOK.klc on other PC with Win11, built via MSKLC: Project/Build DLL and Setup Package, installed that setup package back in Win10, switched keyboard to SlovakOK and solved the problem.
I made special keyboard layout to use common layout in different language scripts for my needs as well.

Q: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno 11001] getaddrinfo failed' in Python 3.9 A:

Please wrap response = requests.post(url,json=vaxrecord, headers=headers, timeout=5) line with try-catch block

while retry_counter < 5:
  try:            
      response = requests.post(url,json=vaxrecord, headers=headers, timeout=5)
   except socket.error as error:
       print("Connection Failed due to socket - {}").format(error)
       print("Attempting {} of 5").format(retry_counter)
       time.sleep(3)
       retry_counter  += 1

NOTE: Generally retrying code after some time in socket error case will resolve the issue(happened in my case) hence the below solution

while doing request.post, if socket.error occurs then retry the code 3-5 time with a delay of your 1-3 seconds.

Q: Delete old entries of the event-log with PowerShell? A:

I found a one-liner to remove ALL entries from ALL eventlogs e.g.

wevtutil el | Foreach-Object {Write-Host "Clearing $_"; wevtutil cl "$_"}

Personally I either set a limit on eventlog size

limit-eventLog -logname Security -MaximumSize 64KB

or do a monthly export and delete after export.
